act-written-by-a-system.invalid.json.reason: an act version is written by a human in the chart; a system's decision content is a recommendation (CA-10, CD-52)

ai-party-without-openwallet.invalid.json.reason: an AI is identified by its openWallet ID (AN-02)

amended-first-version.invalid.json.reason: only a later version can carry the status amended

amendment-without-supersedes.invalid.jso.reason: a later version must reference the version it supersedes

author-type-ai.invalid.json.reason: an act's author type is clinician; act content from an AI is entered as a recommendation record instead (CA-02, AN-09)

cosigned-without-cosigner-signature.inva.reason: a co-signed requirement carries the co-signer's signature (CA-07)

derived-from-unknown-kind.invalid.json.reason: derivation sources are intake statements and clinical communications only

device-id-kind-without-id.invalid.json.reason: a device ID kind is given only with a device ID (AN-13)

device-party-without-serial.invalid.json.reason: a device is identified by make, model and serial, or a resolvable device ID (AN-02, AN-13)

diagnosis-uncoded.invalid.json.reason: a diagnosis of record must be coded

discontinuation-signed-off-as-another-ac.reason: a sign-off names the action it was made for, so it cannot stand for another action (CA-04, CD-53)

encounter-diagnosis-without-encounter.in.reason: an encounter diagnosis must reference its encounter

encounter-final-without-end.invalid.json.reason: a signed encounter has an end time

entered-in-error-without-event.invalid.j.reason: an entered-in-error act must carry the attributed entered_in_error event with a reason code

entered-in-error-without-sign-off.invali.reason: an entered-in-error mark is a decision and carries the practitioner's sign-off (CA-06)

external-human-with-role.invalid.json.reason: a person outside this chart holds no openChart clinical role (CD-57)

final-without-signature.invalid.json.reason: a signed status needs the author's signature

information-without-marker.invalid.json.reason: a note kept as information is marked not signed off wherever it is shown (AN-14, CD-63)

note-draft-closed-without-information-re.reason: a note draft closed because its content was kept as information names that record (AN-14)

note-request-status.invalid.json.reason: a clinical note has no release lifecycle

order-unknown-category.invalid.json.reason: order category outside the closed list

party-field-of-another-kind.invalid.json.reason: a party carries only its own kind's identifying fields (AN-02)

patient-external-namespace.invalid.json.reason: the patient is always the openChart triple; an external identifier never replaces it

patient-self-with-representative.invalid.reason: a patient acting for themselves names no representative (AN-02)

prescription-missing-classification.inva.reason: a prescription must carry its controlled-substance classification

prescription-transmission-state.invalid..reason: transmission and dispense states are reserved for a later governed change

recommendation-adopted-without-act.inval.reason: adoption creates a decision of the clinician's own, and the recommendation names it (AN-11)

recommendation-claim-without-claimant.in.reason: a decision a system carried for an unconfirmed decision maker names who was claimed (AN-08)

recommendation-claimant-without-code.inv.reason: a claimed decision maker is named only where the decision maker was not confirmed (AN-08)

recommendation-content-schema-on-cosign..reason: content declared under another schema is kept only for an action that carries content (AN-09, CD-51)

recommendation-marked-authorized.invalid.reason: a recommendation is always marked not an authorized decision (AN-09)

recommendation-path-reason-without-schem.reason: a writing path's own reason names the scheme that defines it (AN-09, CD-51)

recommendation-pending-with-reason.inval.reason: a decline reason belongs to a declined recommendation only (AN-11)

recommendation-sign-with-target.invalid..reason: a sign-off of new content names no existing act (AN-09)

recommendation-unknown-missing-authority.reason: missing_authority uses the closed code list (AN-09, CD-45)

recommendation-with-act-status.invalid.j.reason: a recommendation has no act status (AN-09)

recommendation-without-missing-authority.reason: a recommendation says which authority was missing (AN-09)

record-kind-missing.invalid.json.reason: every record says which record kind it is

released-while-cosignature-pending.inval.reason: an order held for a before-effect co-signature is not in force until it is co-signed (CA-07, OR-02)

sign-off-holder-readable-custody.invalid.reason: only a key whose custody evidences that the holder acted can sign off (CA-04; openWallet's custody registry)

sign-off-without-statement.invalid.json.reason: the openSig attestation is made over the sign-off statement, whose digest is recorded (CA-04, CD-53)

signature-without-sign-off.invalid.json.reason: a signature carries the practitioner's openWallet and openSig sign-off evidence (CA-04, ruling 151)

signed-order-cancelled-without-sign-off..reason: cancelling a signed order is a decision and carries the practitioner's sign-off (OR-02)

timestamp-not-date-time.invalid.json.reason: every time is an RFC 3339 date-time with a time zone

writer-identity-asserted.invalid.json.reason: a writer's identity is always verified by the chart (AN-02, CD-42)

writer-named-by-external-ref.invalid.jso.reason: a party named by another system's identifier is vouched for by that system and is never the writer (AN-04, CD-57)
